answer: Because the garden calculation reruns each epoch, the ledge weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the tundra settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 53 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 64% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
